Hi Olivia — great to meet you and the team today. Appreciate the clear priorities. Quick answers inline and a proposed next steps list below. Attaching our quickstart guide and a short rate-limit/pricing XLSX for reference.

Summary of deployment modes (high level):
- Hosted API: fastest to integrate (REST/SDK), immediate sandbox keys, pay-as-you-go pricing. Best for teams wanting low friction and fast iteration. Data handling: optional data controls; enterprise plan adds retention and isolation features.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput and lower unit-cost at scale. Requires a short setup (1–3 weeks depending on capacity and security review). Good when you need consistent latency under heavy traffic.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full isolation, customer-managed networking and KMS. Typically a multi-week engagement (4–8+ weeks including network and compliance setup).

Hosted eval quickstart (what I'll provision for you):
1) Sandbox keys for Hosted API (valid 14 days)
2) Example endpoints (inlined below) and Postman collection
3) Suggested traffic profile for latency tests (small script to ramp QPS)
4) Guidance on rate limits and how to request higher throughput for the eval

Typical Hosted API rate limits for eval accounts:
- Default burst: 60 requests/minute
- Default sustained: 10 requests/minute
- Token-based throttling: backend will throttle if token/second threshold exceeded; we can increase for the POC if you share expected concurrency.

Endpoints (Hosted API sample):
- POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate  (api-key header)
- POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat    (api-key header; streaming supported)

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll create a Hosted eval sandbox and send keys + Postman collection (by EOD today).
2) You share an expected concurrency / sample sequences (50–100 requests of ~300 tokens is fine as a starting point).
3) We run a 48-hour smoke test to validate latency and basic cost numbers.
4) If Dedicated or Private is desired after the POC, I’ll loop in our solutions engineer and security lead to scope network & timeline.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf, rate-limits-and-pricing.xlsx

Let me know if you want to schedule a 30-min setup call tomorrow to provision keys and walk through the Postman collection.
